name: RadioGroup
description: One choice among radios, drawn as Flutter's on both platforms.

label.description: The field's name, drawn above it.

isLabelHidden.description: Hides the label from sight; it still names the field for a screen reader.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the field shows this message under it.

defaultValue.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it.

value.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree.

isRequired.description: The star is on the group's label only.

name.description: Names the value inside a Form block.
